name: user-simulation
description: Synthetic UX testing over a live web app, two complementary lenses. EXPERIENCE (simulation): a synthetic user walks the app and reports friction, doubt and emotion — simulation-run (custom: your profile + URL + task) and simulation-auto (inferred: from just a URL it proposes users and consolidates the runs). INSPECTION (heuristics): heuristic-test runs an expert Nielsen heuristic evaluation, severity-rated by three synthetic personas, into a prioritized findings table. Drives the browser via Playwright MCP.
